title: Country identity & appearance
description: Edit each country's flag, displayed names, map colors, and art style. Ideologies and their shared icons are managed separately.
ideologyIconsLabel: Ideology group icons (4 icons at the bottom of the country selection screen)
ideologyIconsHint: Override vanilla party badge / iron cross / coin / freedom flag · exported to
selectCountry: Pick a country on the left to start editing
flagHintBefore: Upload PNG / JPG / TGA · auto-resized to 82×52 · exported to gfx/flags/
baseModFlagTitle: Flag from the base mod — upload your own to override
nameKeyHint: Exported to yml · key is <mono>{tag}</mono> · used to override the vanilla country name
perIdeologySummary: Name per ideology (optional · leave blank to use default)
perIdeologyHint: A common vanilla trick: show a different country name under each ruling ideology. E.g. fascism → "American Reich", communism → "United Socialist States".
appearanceHint: Map color + graphical_culture (unit & portrait art) · exported to common/countries/TAG.txt · custom alt-history TAGs need this to load with the right color and art.
colorUiHint: Country list / menu color · leave empty = same as map color · takes effect only on a renamed (cosmetic) tag — setting it on an ordinary country has no export effect.
deletePreviewIntro: These entities belong to the selected countries and will be removed too:
deleteAllSkippedLast: Skipped {count} (project's last remaining country cannot be deleted)

shared.countryNotFound: The current country {tag} is not available in this project.

politics.title: Country politics
politics.context: Editing {name} ({tag}) from the one project country context.
politics.openingPoliticsHint: Set support for each ideology, the current ruling group, and election rules. Nothing changes until you save.
politics.supportChartHint: Use the chart for a quick read and the values beside it for exact editing.
politics.supportRangeError: Every support value must be a whole number from 0 to 100.
politics.supportTotalError: Non-empty political support must total exactly 100%.
politics.explicitSaveHint: Saving writes country history and then reads it back.
politics.leadersHint: A leader uses a sub-ideology; candidates may normally have different sub-ideologies.
politics.noLeaders: No country-leader characters are assigned to this country.
politics.leaderMismatch: This sub-ideology belongs to {root}, not the drafted governing group.
politics.leaderMatched: Leader sub-ideology and governing group relationship is consistent.
politics.candidateDifferentNormal: Candidate leaders may use a different sub-ideology; no automatic repair is needed.
politics.prepareRulingRepair: Use this group in the draft
politics.unknownSubtype: Choose a known sub-ideology before saving.
politics.readbackMismatch: The program accepted the change, but reading it back did not match. Your draft was kept.

profile.capitalCanonical: Stored only through the canonical country-history record.
profile.variantsHint: Display overrides only. They never change governing politics or support.
profile.genericFlagFallback: Falls back to the generic country flag
profile.variantNamePlaceholder: Blank uses the generic country name
profile.genericNameFallback: Falls back to the generic country name
profile.identityNotPolitics: These fields control player-visible identity, not politics.
profile.previewNotEngineProof: Preview in the program, not HOI4 engine proof
